versions.changelog:
- Added a "Recommended Companions" section listing useful integrations for enhanced functionality.
- No changes to core features or implementation; documentation improvement only.

Initial public release of Heartbeat Pro:

- Adds health-checking capabilities for any service URL.
- Enables agent discovery, network coordination, and open bounty checks via OADP and ClawSwarm integration.
- Provides uptime tracking and heartbeat reliability logging.
- Supports batch platform monitoring and seamless integration with OpenClaw agents.
- Includes quick setup instructions for easy onboarding.
